facts.fact: Julianne Tell 主持《Julianne Tells All》，播报 Farrow 县三镇热门八卦。
facts.anchor: Hello, and welcome to another episode of Julianne Tells All! I’m Julianne Tell, and this is your one-stop shop for all the hottest gossip from the Farrow County Tri-towns.

facts.fact: 本周 Heath 筹备三镇丰收节，Miss Daisy 再次招志愿者，南瓜田报名。
facts.anchor: This week, planning is underway in Heath for the Tri-towns Harvest festival, and Miss Daisy is once again looking for volunteers. Drop into the pumpkin patch to sign up.

facts.fact: Farrow 高二生 George Cunningham 六十二码射门破校纪录，击败 Burns Bulldogs。
facts.anchor: sophomore George Cunningham set a brand new school record for the longest field goal when he kicked and scored from sixty-two yards to beat the Burns Bulldogs.

facts.fact: Skillett 的 Ellison 蓝莓司康之外推出新口味橙子巧克力豆。
facts.anchor: Ellison’s famous blueberry scones have been joined with a brand new flavor: orange chocolate chip.

facts.fact: Julianne 呼吁三镇听众把八卦短信给她。
facts.anchor: If you’ve got any hot gossip from Farrow, Heath, or Skillett, I wanna be in the know. You can text me on…
